question: What act of sprinkling should the practitioner recollect during this visualization?
premises: The visualized figure is being sprinkled.
The sprinkling is done by all with milk-water.
The practitioner should recollect this image.
inference: One should recollect the figure as being sprinkled by all with milk-water.
uncertainties: The exact intended reading of kṣīrodavi(śe is unclear due to the incomplete or irregular surface.
plain_english: One should recollect him as being sprinkled by all with excellent milk-water.
